certified_type.description: Fuel Dispenser for Motor Vehicles, model SK700, comprising one or more measuring systems in the same housing with one common calculator and indicating device (model Sandpiper, manufacturer Gilbarco GmbH & Co. KG). Each configuration consists of a Blackmer GD-090 or GD-140, or a Gilbarco GPU-90 combined pump and gas elimination device, one or two measurement transducers (type ECO-meter or C+) and one or two matching pulsers (ME 01-02 for ECO-meter; 94Q032 or SK700 for C+). Optionally the combined pump and gas elimination device is replaced by a submerge pump (Red Jacket Petroleum Systems or FE-Petro), which can serve multiple measuring systems. Two measuring systems (two dispensers) can use one common pump and one gas elimination device, in which case there are two measurement transducers both delivering the same fuel to two delivery points that can be used at the same time. In the high flow configuration the dispenser contains two measurement transducers in parallel and fuel is dispensed by one nozzle; optionally one (with or without high speed switch) or more extra delivery points with corresponding valves can be used but not simultaneously. If one measurement transducer is connected to more than one delivery point, simultaneous delivery of liquid with these points is not possible.

certified_type.description: Fuel dispensers for Motor Vehicles, model "Global Vista" with a Qmax of 40, 70, 90, or 130 L/min. In case of blending the Qmax is 40 L/min. Comprising of one or more measuring systems in the same housing. Each measuring system consists of one Dresser Wayne AB CPU (Compact Pumping Unit) combined pump and gas eliminator device, one Dresser Wayne AB measurement transducer and one Dresser Wayne AB iGEM calculating/indicating device. One CPU combined pump and gas eliminator can be connected with two measurement transducers, each measurement transducer is considered as a part of a measuring system. When more than one measuring system in one housing the iGEM calculating/indicating device may be a common part of the measuring systems. A Qmax of 130 L/min can be reached by connecting two gas separators and two measurement transducers in parallel with delivery via one hose with nozzle. For multi-product dispensers it is only possible to deliver one product at the same time on one side of the dispenser.

certified_type.description: Fuel dispenser for Motor Vehicles, model Global Century, comprising one or more hydraulic subsystems in the same housing, with one common electronics, iGEM, able to serve up to two customers at a time. The hydraulic modules included in following description may be duplicated within the same measuring assembly. The limiting numbers for the iGEM to handle is 4 motors, 4 pulse generators (each handling a single or a duplex), 8 nozzles and 10 solenoid valves. Some of the measuring assemblies can be equipped as dispenser variant D (central pump design) and is then designated with an additional "D", e.g. Global Century Duo 40/40 island D (3/G2203 D). If the model is a dispenser variant (with the additional marking "D") an external (central) pump is used instead of an internal pump/air separator. The external system must comply with OIML 117, item 5.1.3 (i.e. it shall be equipped with an arrangement that prevents air to come into the system).

issuing_authority.name: Federal Office of Metrology METAS, Certification Body METAS-Cert

certified_type.description: Family of electromagnetic flow meters intended for the metering of cold water. Covers nominal diameters DN25 to DN200 (10 nominal diameters). Designed for a nominal pressure of 16 bar and a maximal water temperature of 60 °C. Measures the flow of electrically conductive mediums (water) by means of the electromagnetic flow measuring system; the conductive medium flows through a magnetic field which induces a voltage proportional to the mean flow speed. The converter of the sensor manages the input and output signals and converts the data. Versions: compact flow meter (converter and flow sensor fixed together) and split version (converter and flow sensor connected via cable). Accessory components: none.

The family of water meters AMFLO MAG Pro covers the nominal diameters in the range of DN25 to DN200 consisting of 10 nominal diameters. The water meters are designed for a nominal pressure of 16 bar and a maximal water temperature of 60 °C. Designed for measuring the flow of electrically conductive mediums (water) by means of the electromagnetic flow measuring system. The conductive medium flows through a magnetic field which induces a voltage proportional to the mean flow speed as the magnitude of the magnetic field is kept constant and the nominal pipe diameter is a constant factor. The converter of the sensor manages the input and output signals and converts the data. Versions: Compact flow meter (converter and flow sensor fixed together) and Splitversion (converter and flow sensor connected via cable). The converter corrects the sensor linearly with the k-factor.

issuing_authority.name: National Weights and Measures Laboratory (Part of the National Measurement Office)

certified_type.description: Class III or IIII, mains or battery-operated, self-indicating, single-interval, non-automatic weighing instrument. It consists of a #821G indicator connected to a weighing platform. Main features: LCD display, operator's keypad (numerical and function keys), stainless steel casing. Devices: initial zero-setting, semi-automatic zero setting, zero-tracking, semi-automatic subtractive tare weighing, zero-indicator, determination of stability of equilibrium, net indicator, units change (kg or g), weight bar, totalisation. Any compatible load cell may be used provided it has a respective OIML R60 Certificate of Conformity containing the necessary data for the manufacturer's declaration of compatibility of modules; compatibility of load cells and indicator is established by means of the compatibility of modules calculation.

Each measuring system consists of one Dresser Wayne AB "CPU" (Compact Pumping Unit) combined pump and gas eliminator device, one Dresser Wayne AB "iMeter" or "Xflo" measurement transducer and one Dresser Wayne AB "iGEM" calculating / indicating device. One CPU combined pump and gas eliminator can be connected with two measurement transducers, each measurement transducer being considered as a part of a measuring system. When more than one measuring system is in one housing, the "iGEM" calculating / indicating device may be a common part of the measuring systems. A Qmax of 130 L/min can be reached by connecting two gas separators and two measurement transducers in parallel with delivery via one hose with nozzle. For multi-product dispensers it is only possible to deliver one product at the same time on one side of the dispenser. Conformity is also attested with OIML R118 Edition 1995.

register.name: Digital strain gauge compression load cell - Type: PR 6204

certified_type.description: Digital strain gauge compression load cell. The load cells of the series PR 6204 are compact compression load cells for self-centering pendulum applications. The strain gauge application is hermetically sealed; the deep-drawn and micro plasma welded housing is made of stainless steel and filled with inert gas. The analog signal of the strain gauge bridge is amplified, scaled and filtered by the integrated module. The load cell is equipped with an interface RS485. To use the load cell it has to be connected to the junction box of the type PR6024/64S or to the junction box of the type PR6024/68S. The junction box has to be connected to the digital data processing device of the type TN-PRO.

register.name: Automatic gravimetric filling instruments - Type: CCW-R, CCW-RS and CCW-RV

certified_type.description: This family of automatic gravimetric filling instruments, designated the CCW-R, CCW-RS and CCW-RV, is designed for dispensing predetermined loads of powdered, granular or liquid materials. The instruments consist of a feeding device, a number of weighing units, and a weighing controller. Each model is designated the CCW-xx-2nn, with xx the type of instrument (R, RS or RV) and nn the number of weighing units. The instruments operate as associative (selective combination) weighers, and derive the most appropriate combination of loads in one or more weighing unit for discharge as a fill so that the target weight selected by the user is achieved.

Devices: initial zero setting device, semi-automatic zero setting device, zero tracking device (around Gross or Net zero), zero indicator, net indicator, stable weight indicator, semi-automatic subtractive tare weighing device, gravity compensation, price-computing, totalisation (including non-weighed items), PLU, fixed weight labelling, multi-vendor operation, calibration/set-up mode via sealed internal switch. Interfaces (some optional): RS232C, cash drawer, USB Device, USB Host, RS485, ZigBee, wired LAN, wireless LAN. Software identified by version number displayed at power-up, shall be 1.xx (xx = non-legally relevant modifications); download not possible without breaking the seal. Load cell, EPROM and calibration switch protected by sealing the enclosure via wire-and-seal or tamper-evident label. Optional Preset Tare device: semi-automatic tare then acts as balancing tare device, with Tare and Preset Tare values limited to Max1. CT100 PLUS variants fitted with a modified integrated printer.

certified_type.description: Separate digital data processing module (digital transmitter) intended to be integrated in a non-automatic weighing instrument. It is intended to be connected on one end to 2, 3 or 4 analogue and/or digital data processing units that have an OIML-MAA-R76 certificate, and on the other end to a compatible terminal that has an OIML-MAA-R76 certificate. The module is never directly connected to a load cell; it manages a weighing channel by summing values provided by the connected weighing channels, performs processing and control of the summation, and digitally transmits the processed summation to the connected terminal. certified_type.description: Multi jet rotary vane wheel water meters with dry mechanical indicating device (plastic can calculator) or super dry mechanical indicating device (plastic can calculator or copper can calculator). DS 90 TAR and DS 04 TAR consist of a brass, bronze, iron or plastic body with connecting threads or flanges and inlet strainer, an adjusting screw, a wet measuring unit, a register chamber with two magnet shields and two corundum bearings, two O-rings, a dry mechanical indicating device, a tempered glass, two fixed rings, a sliding gasket and a brass, bronze or plastic cap with a lid. DS 97 TAR consist of a brass, bronze or plastic body with connecting threads and inlet strainer, an adjusting screw, a wet measuring unit, a pressure plate with magnet shield, a shield gasket, an O-ring and a separating plate with corundum bearings, a super dry mechanical indicating device with transparent plastic cover (plastic can calculator) or with copper can with tempered glass (copper can calculator), an O-ring, a lower plate with an agate bearing and a plastic cap with a plastic lid. Adjustment is made by an adjusting screw covered by an adjusting plug. Intended for mounting to horizontal pipework with the flow axis in the horizontal plane and the indicating device positioned at the top. Indicating devices: numbered rollers with five drums and four rotary pointers (DN15-DN32) or six drums and three or four rotary pointers (DN40-DN50), or eight drums with one rotary pointer (DN15-DN32) or one or two rotary pointers (DN40-DN50); calculators can be designated for inclined reading; a ten-armed star wheel is available for rapid testing. The water meters can be equipped with a reed impulse transmitter for remote reading. Markings: unit of measurement (m³), numerical value Q3 and ratio Q3/Q1 (R80, R50), OIML certificate of conformity number, manufacturer trademark, year of manufacture and serial number, direction of flow arrow, maximum admissible pressure (MAP 16), letter H, temperature class (T50, T30). The connection of the adjusting plug and the brass ring of the meter has to be sealed.

certified_type.description: A density sensor (a sensor as part of a densitometer). In the metal housing two parallel tubes are mounted which are set into vibrating motion by a drive coil controlled by the transmitter. Two pick-off coils generate signals representative of the frequency of motion of the measurement tubes; the resonance frequency depends, among other things, on the density of the liquid in the tubes. The transmitter can output the resonance frequency directly or via serial communication. Together with the calibration constants, a connected flow computer (optionally with external process pressure and temperature transmitters) can calculate the liquid density under metering conditions and/or under standard conditions.

register.name: Water meter - Type: MUT2200EL/MC608A

certified_type.description: The water meter type MUT2200EL/MC608A is an induction water meter (compact version). The flow sensors type MUT2200EL are intended for metering cold potable water, based on an induction principle, with PTFE lining, with straight inlet (5 times the diameter) and outlet (3 times the diameter) length, without flow conditioner. The water meters are equipped with an electronic calculating/indicating device type MC608A. The display shows the measurements in cubic metre volume and cubic metre per hour flow rate. The display is a digital type with four buttons and can show up to 3 lines. The meter is not designed to measure reverse flow. The meter does not require any extra-mechanical housing. The adjustment is made by setting calibration factor (KA factor). The meter is intended for mount to the connecting horizontal pipework with the flow axis in the horizontal plane and with the indicating device positioned at the top. Tamper protection by multi-level password; the third level password secures metrological parameters.

register.name: Water meter - Type: MAGB1

certified_type.description: Electromagnetic water meter for metering cold and hot potable water, based on the inductive principle, with PTFE and hard rubber lining, straight inlet (5 x DN) and outlet (3 x DN) lengths, without flow conditioner, equipped with an electronic calculating/indicating device. Two modifications: compact and remote version (maximum cable length 6 m for the remote version; optional frequency output for remote reading). Digital display with up to 9 digits shows volume in m³ (positive, negative, total and auxiliary) and flow rate in m³/h; a high-resolution mode (0.001 L) for calibration is set by factory software. Not designed to measure reverse flow; no extra-mechanical housing or adjustments required. Mounting with flow axis horizontal or vertical (bottom-to-top and top-to-bottom), indicating device positioned at the top or at the side. Sealed at the screw-connected cover plate inside the electronics and at the screw covering the USB port.

register.name: Dispenser for compressed natural gas type OCEAN BMP 40xx.Oxx/CNG

certified_type.description: CNG dispenser type OCEAN BMP 40xx.Oxx/CNG is designed for measurement of quantities of the natural compressed gas. The dispenser may be designed for one to three sequential fillings and consists of shut off valves, strainers, electromagnetic valves, back valves, mass meters, pressure transducers, manometers, hoses with break away couplings, delivery nozzles with three way valve, measurement transducers with electronic transmitters, electronic calculator and indicating devices. The CNG dispenser type OCEAN MOD 40xx.OEx/CNG is a module which is incorporated into a standard liquid dispenser and/or LPG dispenser, with calculator(s) and indicating device(s) mounted beside the indicating device of the main dispenser. The CNG dispenser can be equipped with up to four measurement systems, each connected to its own electronic calculator, and can fill up to four cars simultaneously.

Intended for mounting onto pipework with the flow axis in horizontal and vertical planes, with the indicating device positioned at the top or at the side. Covers nominal diameters DN25 to DN300.

certified_type.description: A density sensor (a sensor as a part of a densitometer). In the metal housing of the density sensor, two parallel tubes are mounted which are set into a vibrating motion by a drive coil controlled by the transmitter. The two pick-off coils generate signals representative for the frequency of motion of the measurement tubes. The resonance frequency depends, among other things, on the density of the liquid in the measurement tubes. The transmitter can output this resonance frequency either directly or via serial communication. Together with the calibration constants, a flow computer, to which the density sensor is connected and to which optionally external process pressure and temperature transmitters are connected, can calculate the liquid density under metering conditions and/or under standard conditions.

register.name: Water meter - Type: MUT2200EL/MC608A

certified_type.description: The water meter type MUT2200EL/MC608A is an induction water meter (compact version). The flow sensors type MUT2200EL are intended for metering cold potable water, based on an induction principle, with PTFE or ebonite lining, with straight inlet (5 times the diameter) and outlet (3 times the diameter) length, without flow conditioner. The water meters are equipped with an electronic calculating/indicating device type MC608A. The display shows the measurements in cubic meter volume and cubic meter per hour flow rate. The display is a digital type with four buttons and can show up to 3 lines. The adjustment is made by setting the calibration factor (KA factor). The meter is intended for mounting to horizontal pipework with the flow axis in the horizontal plane and with the indicating device positioned at the top. The meter is designed to measure reverse flow with recording flow volume separately.

register.name: Water meter  - volumetric - Type: LXH-15, LXH-20

certified_type.description: Volumetric (semi-positive displacement rotary piston) water meters with wet mechanical indicating device with protected registered drums. Body of brass (LXH, LXHY) or composite (LXHY-15/S, LXHY-20/S), divided into two parts connected by screws, with connecting screw threads, inlet strainer, wet measuring unit with piston and mechanical transmission, rubber O-ring, and a mechanical indicating device protected by a plastic cover. The indicating device consists of numbered rollers with eight drums installed in a capsule filled with special liquid. Not designed to measure reverse flow. Intended for mounting on pipework with the flow axis in the horizontal and vertical (bottom-to-top and top-to-bottom) plane, with the indicating device positioned at the top or at the side. To prevent tampering, the brass or composite body parts are sealed together with a wire and lead seal.

register.name: Water meter - Type: 280W-. . .

certified_type.description: The ultrasonic water meters type 280W-R intended for metering cold potable water, based on an ultrasonic transit-time principle, with straight inlet (5 times the diameter) and outlet (3 times the diameter) length, without flow conditioner and equipped with an electronic calculating/indicating device. The display shows the measurements in cubic meter volume and cubic meter per hour flow rate. The meter is not designed to measure reverse flow. The meter does not require any extra-mechanical housing or adjustments. The meter is intended for mount to the connecting horizontal, vertical and diagonal pipework with the flow axis in the horizontal, vertical and diagonal plane and with the indicating device positioned at the top and at the side. The meter is equipped with the electronic indicating device. The display is a digital type, and can show up to 9 digits. The meter has two indication modes: high resolution mode (used during calibration) and normal resolution mode. In the high resolution mode the water meter displays the volume resolution of 0.000001 m³ on the digital display. In the normal resolution mode the water meter displays up to 000000.001 m³/h flow rate and 0000000.01 m³ volume on the digital display. The water meters type 280W-R can be equipped by M-bus transmitter which can be used for remote reading.

certified_type.description: The CWS™ Loadpin is an automatic catchweigher designed to weigh containers statically with no operator intervention. The instrument comprises digital load cells, an interface unit and a control and display unit. The load cells and electronics are permanently installed on the spreader of container handlers; weight values are transmitted via the interface unit to the display unit (typically in the operator's cab) and to the Terminal Operating System (TOS). Enclosures are aluminium; the display unit has an LCD display and 8 keys (6 functional control keys, 2 navigation keys). Interfaces: RS 232 / RS 422 / RS 485, CANBUS, Ethernet, Wifi. Devices: semi-automatic zero-setting (≤ 4% Max) via user interface or TOS, long term storage device, display and storage of individual and total weights. Securing: seal on electronics enclosures, indelible load cell serial numbers on data plate, tamper-evident label with Config Version counter.

register.name: Water meter - Type: MAGB1

certified_type.description: The water meter type MAGB1 is electromagnetic water meter. There are two modifications: compact and remote version. The water meters type MAGB1 are intended for metering cold potable water and hot water, based on an inductive principle, PTFE and hard rubber lining, with straight inlet (5 times the diameter) and outlet (3 times the diameter) length, without flow conditioner and there are equipped with an electronic calculating/indicating device. The maximum cable length for remote version is 6 meters. The display shows the measurements in cubic meter volume (positive, negative, total and auxiliary) and cubic meter per hour flow rate. The meter is not designed to measure reverse flow. The meter does not require any extra-mechanical housing or adjustments. The meter is intended for mount to the connecting any pipework with the flow axis in the horizontal and vertical (from bottom to top and from top to bottom) plane and with the indicating device positioned at the top and at the side. The meter is equipped with the electronic indicating device. The display is a digital type, and can show up to 9 digits. The normal resolution mode is used during normal operation. The water meter displays in the normal resolution mode up to 000000.001 m³/h flow rate and 000.001 m³ volume on the digital display. The water meter displays the volume resolution of 0.001 L on the digital display in the high resolution mode which would be used during the calibration process. This mode is set up by factory tool (software had to be attached). The water meters type MAGB1 can be equipped by frequency output which can be used for remote reading or by RS 485 (with maximum cable length 3 m).

register.name: Type 420 Series

certified_type.description: Family of mains-powered, single-interval, automatic weighing instruments (checkweighers, Category X) designated the TS420 Series, designed to weigh packs dynamically. The instruments comprise a cabinet, touch screen user interface (HMI), in-feed and out-feed conveyors, a weighing unit with weigh conveyor, mechanical handling facilities and sorting devices, and may be equipped with a metal detector. Constructed in stainless steel on a fabricated floor-standing frame with adjustable feet; photocells on the frame detect packs; the control cabinet houses the electrical hardware including the A/D board and flash card memory holding legally relevant parameters. Models are designated 420 Series with functional prefixes (e.g. Sentinel 420 for stand alone, Cerberus 420 for metal detection, Theia 420 for X-ray). Weighing device is a strain gauge load cell below the centre of the weigh conveyor. Devices: semi-automatic zero setting, zero tracking, initial zero setting, pre-set tare, data storage device. Interfaces: Ethernet and USB. CF card, HMI board and load cell connection to the electronics are sealed via a tamper-evident solution. Alternatively, any compatible load cell may be used provided it has a respective OIML R60 Certificate of Conformity with the necessary data for the declaration of compatibility of modules, is not a load cell with digital output, has n_lc, Y, Z the same or better than the tested HBM PW16AC3 (Emax = 30 kg), has the same design and material, uses no oil damper, and has sensitivity greater than 0.33 uV/div. Legally relevant software consists of two parts (HMI and Controller) held in read-only directories; parameters are secured by password and a non-editable Parameter Modification Counter, and calibration by password and a Calibration Count, both held on the Controller.

register.name: CWS Loadpin

certified_type.description: Automatic catchweigher designed to weigh containers statically with no operator intervention. The instrument comprises Loadpin digital load cells, an interface unit (spreader unit) and a control and display unit (control unit). The load cells and electronics are permanently installed on the spreader of the container handler; weight values are transmitted from the load cells via the interface unit to the display unit and on to the Terminal Operating System (TOS). The interface and display units have aluminium enclosures; the display unit comprises a communications and display controller with an LCD display and 8 keys (6 functional control keys and 2 navigation keys). The units are powered by the container handler via a nominal 24 V DC external source; the interface unit supplies the strain gauge bridges of the load cells. Devices: semi-automatic zero-setting (≤ 4% Max) via user interface or TOS, long term storage device, display and storage of individual and total weights. Interfaces: link between interface and display unit, RS 232 / RS 422 / RS 485, CANBUS, Ethernet, Wifi. Software is protected by a version number and checksum held on the eMMC memory; access to legally relevant parameters is password-protected with a non-editable Config Version counter.

Legally relevant software is designated version V2.xx.xx; access to legally relevant parameters and software download only possible by pressing the calibration switch on the CPU board. certificate.member_state: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

certified_type.description: Family of mains-powered, dual-range, automatic weighing instruments designated the DACS-G-S015 and DACS-G-S060 Series, operating as automatic checkweighers (Category X). Models are designated DACS-G-S015-xx/xx-xx-x and DACS-G-S060-xx/xx-xx-x, with x reflecting the various configurations. Stainless steel construction: fabricated floor-standing frame on adjustable feet carrying in-feed, weigh and out-feed conveyors (conveyor type and size not restricted). Control cabinet behind the conveyors houses the electrical hardware, including the ADC board and the dip-switches protecting the legally-relevant parameters; the Remote Control Unit is mounted in the upper part of the control cabinet; photocells mounted on the frame are used for pack detection; a printer is located on the side of the control cabinet. Weighing device comprises a strain gauge load cell below the centre of the weigh conveyor. Weighing controller comprises the A/D converter on the weigh board; processed weigh signal and photocell signal are sent to the DRV board controlling the infeed/outfeed conveyors. certified_type.description: The Sartorius PMA is a family of self-indicating, single-interval, non-automatic weighing instruments designed to be used in paint mixing applications. The family comprises the PMA-EV (Class II) and the PMA-HD (Class III) types, each comprising several models. The instrument shall not be used for direct sales to the public. Construction: plastic construction, stainless steel load receptor, plastic display head, 3 feet (2 adjustable), level indicator, LCD segment display with fixed position touch keys (EVO1, LAB1, SPO1), LCD graphic display with touch function (VIS1), EX-link converter for voltage supply and data transfer (X and Y models except EVO1Y). Devices: initial zero setting device (max 20% of Max), zero tracking device (max 4% of Max), zero indicator (PMA-HD only), combined zero-setting and tare-balancing device, preset tare device (only via a PC), approximate displaying device (PMA-EV only), weight accumulation, weight calculating. A PC with compatible paint mixing software can be connected via the interfaces provided; all devices can be initiated via a PC, preset tare can only be introduced via a PC. Interfaces: USB either directly (S models and EVO1Y) or via Ex-link converter (EVO1X and LAB1X); Ethernet via Ex-link converter (VIS1X and VIS1Y models). Power supply: 5 V DC provided by USB; for X and Y models except EVO1Y, power is delivered from USB to the Ex-link converter and then to the instrument via RJ-45. Software: permitted versions are weighing instrument software BAC (ID 05496, or 1578 for VIS models, version 00-56-02.xx) and software application APC (only VIS models, ID 6587, version 01-72-03.xx), where xx reflects legally non-relevant changes. Sealing: access to the electronics and load cell is prevented by two tamper-evident labels on the underside of the instrument; access to the Menu access switch is prevented by a tamper-evident label covering the switch.

certified_type.description: The WM-AI model is a Class III, self-indicating, dual-interval, non-automatic weighing instrument with wrapping and label printing devices. The IP-AI model is a weigh-price labelling instrument with similar characteristics and operation, but without the wrapping function. The instruments are not designed for direct sales to the public. Main features: weighing module mounted in the in-feed conveyor section within a framework of fabricated stainless steel; load cell mounted in an enclosed housing and supporting the weighing module; user display and control interface comprising LCD touch screen display and keyboard; thermal label printers/applicators (maximum three printers); wrapping device (WM-AI only, maximum two film rolls). Interfaces: Ethernet, USB. Sealing: access to the load cell, electronics and calibration switch is prevented by a tamper-evident seal. Permitted alternatives include an in-feed conveyor on the WM-AI, an additional under pack label printer/applicator in the out-feed conveyor, an externally mounted printer on the WM-AI (label applied manually), an additional label printer on the IP-AI, and a modified IP-AI connected to a weighing platform type S (see platform characteristics). A further variant uses a main board with an Intel Atom processor E3800 product family (E38xx models).

register.name: Dispenser for compressed natural gas (CNG) - Type: OCEAN BMP 40xx.Oxx/CNG

certified_type.description: Dispenser for compressed natural gas (CNG), OCEAN dispenser line. Type designation structure BMP 40ab.Oxy/CNG: BMP marks all TATSUNO EUROPE dispensers, 40 marks the OCEAN dispenser line, a = number of pressure banks connected to the dispenser input, b = number of dispensing hoses located in the dispenser, O marks the OCEAN model dispenser line, x = dispenser design (E = EURO, S = SMART, W = TOWER), y = dispenser orientation (D = double-sided, R = single-sided right, L = single-sided left). MOD 40ab.Oxy/CNG marks the additional dispensing module incorporated into a standard liquid dispenser and/or LPG dispenser; for the module a = 1, 2 or 3 and x = E (EURO) is a model with hose column height 1900 mm. The CNG dispenser consists of shut-off valves, strainers, electromagnetic valves, back valves, mass meters, pressure transducers, manometers, hoses with break-away couplings, delivery nozzles with three-way valve, measurement transducers with electronic transmitters, electronic calculator and indicating devices. It may be designed for one to three sequential fillings, can be equipped with up to four measurement systems (each connected to its own electronic calculator) and can fill up to four cars simultaneously. An ambient temperature sensor compensates the maximum filling pressure. The dispenser can be connected to a payment terminal / POS system which does not affect the metrological characteristics. Under the metrological seal the zero flow rate and calibration factor can be set up directly through the CNG dispenser.

certified_type.description: The Alpha is an interruptible meter measuring system for use in the presence of both trading parties when used in standalone mode. The base and internal dispenser frame is constructed from riveted angled stainless steel and stainless-steel panel work, clad with stainless steel panels; the hinged front doors are secured with two key locks (one lower, one upper). The dispenser enclosure may be constructed of steel, aluminium, GRP or a combination of these materials. The graphics display and logic board which form the calculator are mounted in the upper head, with the display viewed through a clear window in the front panel. The dispenser enclosure may be used to house an approved self-service device. The pump unit and meter are supported on the internal dispenser frame; the nozzle holster is made from cast aluminium and mounted on the dispenser side panel. Conditional characteristics: the combination of hose type and length is selected to ensure hose dilation does not result in a displayed quantity at the start of a transaction prior to the nozzle being operated; nozzle with built-in non-return valve. Non-essential parts that may be included within the hydraulic circuits: shear valves for use on dispensers, non-return valves separate from the pump and gas separator, and swivels and/or safety breaks in the hose assembly circuit. Software version and checksum are displayed on the LCD for four seconds after lifting and replacing the nozzle without drawing fuel; access to software is secured by wire and seal. Interface: Modbus protocol for connection to a self-service device. The meter, encoder, gas separator and calculator are secured with a wire and seal (see documentation file P02336-01-D).

manufacturers.name: Emerson Process Management Micro Motion Inc.

certified_type.description: Density sensor (a sensor as a part of a densitometer): in the metal housing, two parallel tubes are mounted which are set into a vibrating motion by a drive coil controlled by the transmitter. The two pick-off coils generate signals representative of the frequency of motion of the measurement tubes; the resonance frequency depends, among other things, on the density of the liquid in the measurement tubes. The transmitter can output this resonance frequency either directly or via serial communication. For software version 2.11 onwards, the transmitter when connected to an external pressure and temperature transmitter via HART is capable of calculating the line density and converting it to density at reference conditions; these density values can be output via RS-485 Modbus serial communication, BELL 202 HART protocol or 4...20 mA analog signal. Line density is calculated using Mobrey/Solatron density formulas; conversion to density at reference conditions (0 kPa, 15 °C) uses Tables 53A/53B/53D and to (0 kPa, 20 °C) uses Tables 59A/59B/59D as specified in API Manual of Petroleum Measurements Standards, Chapter 11, Section 1 (ASTM D1250-07). Also capable of concentration measurement calculations of alcohol according to OIML R22, density conversion for Fatty Acid Methyl Ester (FAME) according to EN14214:2008+A1:2009 and density conversion for Methyl Ester. If the time period signal of the device is used as the output, the density sensor, along with pressure and temperature sensors, needs to be connected to a flow computer in which the actual density calculations and conversions take place. For software version 2.10 and lower, together with the calibration constants, a connected flow computer (optionally with external process pressure and temperature transmitters) can calculate the liquid density under line conditions and/or under standard conditions.

certified_type.description: Liquid fuel dispenser type Orion, alternative name Frontier II or Frontier F2. Each hydraulic module consists of one or two measurement sensors (types C+, V or V+ from the C series family of positive displacement meters) and one GPU90 pump and gas separator, except for use in pressurized systems. The dispenser chassis is primarily manufactured from sheet steel, with glass or plastic windows providing visibility of the indicators. Two dispenser chassis sizes are available: the smaller housing may contain one or two hydraulic modules (1 to 4 measuring systems) and the larger housing may contain up to four hydraulic modules (1 to 8 measuring systems). Fuel is transferred by a hose and nozzle assembly. All measuring transducers share a common calculator, type Apollo-2. Indicators allow a maximum of 7 digits for price to pay, 7 digits for volume, and 6 digits for unit price; decimal positions are programmable. When temperature compensation is used, the temperature probe shall meet the requirements in R117-1 (2007) clause 3.7.7 and be located in close vicinity of the sensors. Optional features and functions: communications (remote automation), temperature conversion (ATC), keypads for preset control or use by site attendants, delivery speed selection either by pushbutton or nozzle selection, electronic or electromechanical totalizers, 4 active hose dispenser allowing dispensing from 4 transfer points simultaneously and having 4 associated indicators (displays).

certified_type.description: Family of programmable, self-indicating weighing indicators, mains, DC or battery powered, for use as part of Class III or IIII non-automatic weighing instruments. Model designation format 'Prefix-XYZ': first digit X = enclosure material (S = stainless enclosure); second digit Y = mounting orientation (D = desktop, P = panel mount); third digit Z = display type (3 = IBN with dot graphic, black background with green digits; 4 = dot graphic, green background with black dots, capable of negative image; 5 = large dot graphic, green backlight with black dots, capable of negative image). Devices: semi-automatic zero setting, zero tracking, semi-automatic subtractive tare weighing, pre-set tare, recall of gross indication when tare is active, determination and indication of stability of equilibrium, checking of display, printing, PLUs, alibi storage device, gravity compensation, real time clock, command via external device (PC), and gross/net/tare/preset tare/print/zero/motion/accumulation/over-under weight/network/battery indicators. Single or multi-range / multi-interval (maximum of 3 partial ranges), range in use indicators (multi-range variant), connection to up to 4 load receptors with load receptor number indicator, connection to digital load cells. Interfaces: load cell 4-wire or 6-wire shielded connection, 3 x logic level inputs, 3 x open collector outputs, 3 x RS232 serial ports, 10/100 Ethernet, 2 x USB Host. Optional interface & PCB cards: analogue output card (0-10 VDC and 4-20 mA outputs), current loop card (4-20 mA loop and RS485/RS422), internal wireless LAN card (802.11b/g), USB device card, load cell interface boards (5 V and 10 V excitation), Bluetooth card, DeviceNet card, Profibus card, Ethernet to PoE supply side card, quad DC input/output cards, quad AC input/output cards, external I/O expansion card, programmable digital I/O card.

certified_type.description: The indicating device is designated the Avery Weigh-Tronix ZK840. The indicator is self-indicating, mains, DC or battery-powered, and is designed to be used as part of a Class III, Non-automatic Weighing Instrument. The load receptor(s) may be BSQ digital bases and/or conventional platforms fitted with load cells. Construction: plastic (ABS) enclosure, mountable to a BSQ base or alternatively desk/wall mounted using an optional bracket; ISTN LCD display capable of positive and negative images; 6 operational keys plus touchscreen soft keys. Interfaces: BSQ digital base interface, 3 x logic level inputs, 3 x open collector outputs, 2 x RS232 serial ports, 10/100 Ethernet, USB Device, USB Host. Sealing: calibration and legally relevant parameters protected via physical (sealed jumper on main board) or software means (password and incrementing counters); access to electronics, jumper and load cell connections prevented via tamper-evident seals or wire seals.

The Load Sensing System version 1 is an automatic weighing instrument with four or eight load cells integrated into the spreader twist locks. It is designed for weighing of containers during a normal lift cycle. The system is approved for container handling equipment. The Load Sensing System is an integrated part of the spreader and consists of a control unit, an indication unit, a CANopen network and load cells mounted on each twistlock. The spreader, in turn, is attached to a container handling equipment, for example a Yard Crane, Ship to Shore Crane, Reach Stacker or Straddle Carrier. The indicating unit can display weighing result from single or twin spreaders.

Must be placed on flat, level ground such that the entire underside of the weighing area is supported, and the bubble level indicator within its limiting mark. register.name: Alpha Fuel Dispenser

certificate.member_state: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

certified_type.description: The Alpha is an interruptible meter measuring system for use in the presence of both trading parties when used in standalone mode. The base and internal dispenser frame is constructed from riveted angled stainless steel and stainless-steel panel work, clad with stainless steel panels; the hinged front doors are secured with two key locks (one lower, one upper). The dispenser enclosure may be constructed of steel, aluminium, GRP or a combination of these materials, and may be used to house an approved self-service device. The graphics display and logic board which form the calculator are mounted in the upper head; the display can be viewed through a clear window in the front panel. The pump unit and meter are supported on the internal dispenser frame; the nozzle holster is made from cast aluminium and mounted on the dispenser side panel. Conditional characteristics: the combination of hose type and length is selected to ensure hose dilation does not result in a displayed quantity at the start of a transaction prior to the nozzle being operated; nozzle with built-in non-return valve. Non-essential parts that may be included within the hydraulic circuits: shear valves for use on dispensers, non-return valves separate from the pump and gas separator, swivels and/or safety breaks in the hose assembly circuit. Sealing: the data plate is located on the dispenser enclosure and is destroyed when removed; the meter, encoder, gas separator and calculator are secured with a wire and seal (see documentation file No. P02336-01-D). The software version and checksum number are displayed on the LCD display for four seconds after lifting the nozzle and replacing without drawing fuel; access to software is secured by wire and seal.

Standard interfaces: load cell 4-wire or 6-wire shielded connection, 3 x logic level inputs, 3 x open collector outputs, 3 x RS232 serial ports, 10/100 Ethernet, 2 x USB Host. Optional interface/PCB cards: analogue output (0-10 VDC, 4-20 mA), current loop (4-20 mA, RS485/RS422), internal wireless LAN (802.11b/g), USB device, load cell interface board with 5 V excitation (second platform, max 6 load cells), load cell interface board with 10 V excitation (second platform, max 16 load cells), Bluetooth, DeviceNet, Profibus, Ethernet-to-PoE, quad DC input (4 x 4-30 VDC opto-isolated), quad DC output (4 x 3-60 VDC solid state relay), quad AC input (4 x 120-240 VAC opto-isolated), quad AC output (4 x 20-240 VAC solid state relay), external I/O expansion, programmable digital I/O (8 logic level I/O, pulse counter, frequency measurement, quadrature decode, PWM). Sealing: sealed jumper on main board or software means (password and incrementing counters); tamper-evident or wire seals prevent access to electronics, jumper and load cell connections. Load cells: any compatible load cell(s) with a respective OIML R60 Certificate of Conformity may be used; load cells marked NH allowed only if humidity testing to R76 has been conducted; compatibility established by manufacturer's compatibility of modules calculation at verification; load cell transmission must conform to a standard type.

register.applicant: Petrotec - Assistencia Tecnica ao Ramo Petrolifero, S.A.

applicants.name: Petrotec - Assistencia Tecnica ao Ramo Petrolifero, S.A.

certified_type.description: A gas separator intended to be used as a part of a fuel dispenser. The gas separator is a mechanical gas separator based on the centrifugal principle and positioned after the gear pump in series with the bypass valve. As a result of the lateral injection of the liquid into a pipe the liquid will flow towards the exit of this pipe in a spiral movement. The heavier liquid is pressed to the exterior of the pipe and any present air or vapour bubbles will be collected in the centre. The air discharge pipe placed in the centre conducts the flow through a device called vortex valves, which is an internal leakage when there is no air. The liquid without air leaves the centrifugal vent by an opening on the outside of the pipe and flows into the high-pressure chamber.

KWM2230 is power supplied from an internal lithium D-cell providing long battery life, even with high performance communication. A separate pulse interface can be used for converting the data telegram into volume pulses during calibration of the meter.

register.name: Type: KIS-11

issuing_authority.name: RISE Research Institutes of Sweden AB

certified_type.description: KIS-11 is an analog-passive shear beam load cell supported at one end with the load applied at the other end. KIS-11 has strain gauges that measure the strain arising from the shear forces caused by the load. KIS-11 has a sleeve, which makes it possible to apply the load directly over the strain gauges, eliminating disturbing effects from bending forces. The strain gauges are placed in an I-beam section and are oriented for optimal measurement of the shear force. The load cell is provided with a shielded cable; the shield is not connected to the load cell body. The cable has four wires plus shield, with the ground open at the load cell end. Wiring: RED/GREEN +Excitation, BLACK -Excitation, GREEN/WHITE +Signal, WHITE/RED -Signal. Markings contain the cell type, manufacturer name, serial number, and Emax.

register.name: Measurement device (Coriolis) - Type: LNGmass DNxx

certified_type.description: Coriolis measurement device intended to be used as a part of a measuring instrument. The measurement sensor consists of a housing in which the two parallel measuring tubes are mounted. The measurement tubes are set into a vibrating motion by a drive coil, which is controlled by means of an alternating current generated by the measurement transducer. Two measuring coils are also mounted on the measurement tubes, which generate signals representative of the frequency of the measurement tubes. The frequency of the measurement tubes is representative for the density of the liquid; the time shift between the two signals is representative of the mass flow rate. The electronic module in the measurement transducer consists of an amplifier board and a connection board. LNGmass can be used as the measuring device in the main cryogenic liquid system or in the vapor return line to measure and compensate for the mass of gas returned from the receiving tank. Type designation LNGmass DNxx, where xx denotes the size of the meter (diameter of the in- and outlet in mm).

footnotes.text: With xx denoting the size of the meter (diameter of the in- and outlet in mm).

certified_type.description: Measurement transducer (ultrasonic sensor and associated electronics), brand Caldon. Consists of G3 electronics in combination with either full bore or reduced bore spool piece design. The full-bore design is a cylindrical spool piece with 4 or 8 distinct chord locations for custody transfer metering; the reduced bore spool piece consists of a nozzle-shaped convergent section, a cylindrical throat piece with 4 or 8 distinct chord locations and a divergent section. RTD input (Pt-100) is used for correction of the thermal expansion of the meter body, calculation of the liquid density (this density shall not be used for calculating the delivered mass from the measured volume) and calculation of the viscosity of the liquid; the 244Ci and 244CiRN meters can have two Pt-100 elements, one for each 4-path meter. Variants: [RN] = reducing nozzle variant; [LT] = low temperature variant; [-R] = remote mounted electronics variant. Construction recorded in documentation folder no. TC7381-7.

register.name: Ultrasonic water meter - Type: Topas SONIC (TSO)

certified_type.description: Ultrasonic water meters type TOPAS Sonic with electronic indicating device, designed to measure, memorise and display the volume at metering conditions of water passing through the measurement transducer. The meters consist of a brass body with connecting screw threads, one pair of ultrasonic transducers and the electronic indicating device formed by an LCD display showing volume and flow. Volume resolution of 0.001 m³ on the digital display. No buttons; legally non-relevant communication with the meter is possible via an NFC sensor connected on the register. Software separation is applied; SW version and CRC of the legally relevant part are displayed in the auto-rounding menu on the LCD display. The meter displays the indication of each volume every ten seconds — separately for reverse flow and separately for forward flow. Battery powered 3.6 V DC. Can be installed to operate in arbitrary positions; internal pipe dimensions are the same for each size.

register.name: Measuring device (Coriolis), intended to be used as a part of a measuring instrument - Type: LNGmass DNxx

certified_type.description: A Coriolis measurement device intended to be used as a part of a measuring instrument, for the measurement of Liquified Natural Gas (LNG). The measurement sensor consists of a housing in which two parallel measuring tubes are mounted, set into vibrating motion by a drive coil controlled by the measurement transducer; two measuring coils generate signals representative of the frequency of the tubes (representative for the density of the liquid), and the time shift between the two signals is representative of the mass flow rate. The electronic module in the measurement transducer consists of an amplifier board and a connection (IO) board. LNGmass can be used as the measuring device in the main cryogenic liquid system or in the vapor return line, to measure and compensate for the mass of gas returned from the receiving tank. Certified type LNGmass DNxx, where xx denotes the size of the meter (diameter of the in- and outlet in mm); sizes covered: DN08, DN15, DN25. The construction of the measuring instrument is recorded in the Documentation folder no. TC8502-1.

register.name: Ultrasonic water meter - Type: KWM4230

certified_type.description: KWM4230 is an integrated and hermetically sealed static water meter based on the ultrasonic measuring principle. The meter body is made of a composite housing combined with a body fully made of stainless steel and equipped with black coated split flanges made in cast iron. Volume measurements are made by means of bidirectional ultrasonic technique according to the transit time method. The meter has a display indicating the registered volume, measuring unit, error codes and more, plus an optical eye on the front for data reading and configuration. It is powered by 2 x D-cell batteries (replaceable) and provides a separate pulse interface for converting the data telegram into volume pulses during calibration of the meter.

register.name: Water meter, inductive - Type: MAGB2

certified_type.description: Electromagnetic (inductive) water meters type MAGB2, in compact and remote version (maximum cable length 10 m for the remote version). Consist of an inductive flow sensor (PTFE or hard rubber lining, straight inlet and outlet 0 x DN, without flow conditioner) and an electronic calculating/indicating device with digital display (up to 10 digits in two lines, 6 buttons). Normal resolution mode displays up to 00000000.001 m³/h flow rate and 00000000.001 m³ volume; high resolution mode (calibration, set by factory tool protected by user/service/factory passwords) displays volume resolution of 0.001 L. Designed to measure reverse flow. Optionally equipped with frequency output for remote reading and RS 485 (maximum cable length 30 m). Battery powered. Installed in arbitrary positions with flow axis horizontal or vertical (bottom-to-top and top-to-bottom), indicating device at top or at side. Software version 22.28, CRC checksum 0xCB68D76D.

register.name: Continuous totalizing automatic weighing instrument - Type: M2400-B04-FB02-xxx

certified_type.description: The M2400-B04-FB02-xxx according to OIML R50:2014 is a continuous totalizing automatic weighing instrument. It consists of a weighing controller designated M2400-B04 with two analog load cell inputs and a FB02 belt unit with a rigid plastic link belt. The center part of FB02 is the load receptor consisting of two plates fixed in the outer ends and resting end to end in the centre on two individual measured load cells, one in each side of the belt, using wire-rope hangers. The belt width is 922mm (FB02-900). The weighing instruments comes also in a version with 615 mm belt width (FB02-600). The belt speed is measured by a 12 tooth sprocket wheel and a sensor, mounted to the end of the motor drive axle. The belt is pulled over the weighbridge. The software of the tested M2400-B04 has firmware version 1.03-01, checksum 3FBCEF7D, Weighing module version 100 and application version "B4000 v1.06".

register.name: Ultrasonic water meter - Type: sonico EDGE

certified_type.description: Ultrasonic water meters type sonico EDGE designed to measure, memorise and display the volume at metering conditions of water passing through the measurement transducer. They consist of a cast iron body with connecting screw threads, one pair of ultrasonic transducers and an electronic indicating device formed by an LCD display showing volume and flow, with volume resolution of 0.0001 m³ and 0.001 m³. Without buttons; legally non-relevant communication via optical sensor on the register. Software is separated; SW versions and CRCs are shown in the auto-rounding menu on the LCD display. Each volume indication is displayed every two minutes, separately for reverse flow and forward flow; the permanently shown delivered volume is the difference between the two. An optional impulse module is not part of this certificate. Powered from mains 24 V DC with an internal battery for temporary power failure; mains power cable shielding via magnetic ferrite. Installed to operate in arbitrary positions.

certified_type.description: Electromagnetic (inductive) water meters type MAGB2, available in compact and remote versions, consisting of a flow sensor and an electronic calculating/indicating device. Flow sensor works on the induction principle with PTFE and hard rubber lining, straight inlet (0 times the diameter) and outlet (0 times the diameter), without flow conditioner; maximum cable length for the remote version is 10 m; designed to measure reverse flow. Digital display shows up to 10 digits in two lines, equipped with 6 buttons; normal resolution mode shows 0.001 m³ volume (and 0.001 m³/h flow rate); high resolution mode (used during calibration, set via factory tool secured by user, service and factory passwords) shows volume resolution of 0.001 L. May be installed in arbitrary positions with the flow axis horizontal or vertical (bottom-to-top and top-to-bottom) with the indicating device at the top or at the side. Optionally equipped with frequency output for remote reading and RS 485 (maximum cable length 30 m).

certified_type.description: Ultrasonic water meter with dry dial and electronic indicating device, designed to measure, memorise and display the volume at metering conditions of water passing through the measurement transducer. Consists of a cast brass body with connecting screw threads, one pair of ultrasonic transducers and the electronic indicating device formed by an LCD display showing volume and flow. Display volume resolution 0.00001 m³. Without buttons; legally non-relevant communication possible via NFC sensor connected on the register. Software separation is implemented; CRC and SW version of the legally relevant part are displayed in the auto-rounding menu. Displays the delivered volume for reverse flow and for forward flow separately every two minutes; the permanently shown delivered volume is the difference between the two. Can be equipped by an impulse module which is not part of this certificate. Powered by a 3.6 V battery. Shall be installed to operate in any positions. Sealed by a plastic seal (plastic frame holding the display glass) forming part of the meter body.

footnotes.text: The Firmware version number is denoted by the following format: AAA.X.YY.Z - AAA - The major version of the release; - X - The minor version of the release; - YY - The revisions / bug fixes of the release; - Z - The build number of the release. Only a change in AAA is metrologically relevant. The software version for ControlEdge RTU controller is generated through software build process. They can be seen from the software ControlEdge Builder (Menu Help -> About ControlEdge Builder) or while connecting to a controller - Controller Firmware version. The software version, checksum and Code version number can be seen from the software ControlEdge Builder (Application -> Electronic Flow Measurement -> View Diagnostics), and it will be displayed when selecting API in a dropdown bar "Select Group Name".
Checksum of the firmware will remain the same if there is no change in the ControlEdge Library.

If ControlEdge RTU controller loads and runs a calculation project file in the ControlEdge Builder software, The unique "Code version number" of the project file will be made. This code version number is recalculated when the project is built, or when there is an intentional or accidental parameter change. Changes on the code version number are logged in the audit trail.

register.name: Water meter - ultrasonic - Type: UL-DW

certified_type.description: Ultrasonic water meter designed to measure, memorise and display the volume at metering conditions of water passing through the measurement transducer. Consists of a brass body with screw threads, a pair of ultrasonic transducers and an electronic indicating device formed by an LCD display equipped with a photosensitive button. Displays delivered volume for forward flow by default; touching the button twice switches to reverse flow volume. Measures reverse flow and may be installed in arbitrary orientation. Powered by a permanent 3.6 V battery with 16 years lifetime. Legally relevant software (version 7.7.1) is protected by CRC-32, alarm codes, E-SEAL model, passwords and terminal cover sealing; checksum (CRC-32) and software version are shown on the display. Optional M-Bus, wireless M-Bus or RS485 communication interfaces are not part of this certificate.

register.name: Ultrasonic water meter - Type: UL-DW PLUS

certified_type.description: Compact ultrasonic water meter with electronic indication device. It is designed to measure, memorise and display the volume of water passing through the measurement transducer at metering conditions. Intended for the measurement of volume of clean water in residential use, can be installed in all positions and is not designed to measure the reverse flow. The measurement is based on ultrasonic bidirectional transit-time principle.

characteristics.description: Cylindrical brass body with inlet and outlet threaded connections; inner plastic element (casing pipe) placed in the cylindrical brass body; two reflection sheeds installed in the center of the pipe at an angle of 45 degrees with the axis of the pipe section; two ultrasonic transducers at the upstream and downstream of the measurement channel to transmit and receive ultrasonic signals. The flow is measured by the difference in time-of-flight of ultrasonic pulses with flow (downstream) and opposite to flow (upstream).

Plastic housing of the calculator with indication device directly mounted on the flow sensor; main PCB board with LCD display and optical sensor; electronic LCD display (scrolling using optical sensor) with 10 digits and indication range of 999999.9999 m³; non-replaceable lithium battery, lifetime 16 years.

register.name: Coriolis Gas Meter - Type: HPC020 with 5700 transmiter

certified_type.description: Coriolis gas meter, manufacturers mark Micro Motion. The HPC020 High Pressure Coriolis Meter is used with a 5700 transmitter. The measurement sensor consists of a housing in which two parallel measuring tubes are mounted with one drive coil and two pick-off coils; processing of the measurement signals is performed by the same external device that controls the drive coil, and the natural frequency of the tubes is used to determine the gas density. The 5700 transmitter either uses an integral core processor (direct connection to the flow sensor) or is connected to an external core processor. Transmitter hardware and sealing procedure are documented in folder no. TC8519. Installation: measurement sensor and 5700 transmitter must be electronically sealed; programmable parameters: security mode settings, low flow cut off settings, damping settings, slug flow settings, last measured value fault timeout settings. Operation: horizontal flow direction only, no reverse flow during custody transfer; no pressure, temperature or density correction allowed during custody transfer. Verification: zero flow calibration per procedure C-SP-HW-280 for custody transfer in gas applications; one full calibration curve according to OIML R137-1&2:2012 for gas density >= 3.8 kg/m3; calibration with gas similar to the process gas at an ISO17025 lab or with a reference installation traceable to (inter)national standards.

register.name: Water meter - ultrasonic, dry dial - Type: sonico NANO

certified_type.description: Ultrasonic water meter with dry dial, designed to measure, memorise and display the volume at metering conditions of water passing through the measurement transducer. Consists of a cast brass body with connecting screw threads, one pair of ultrasonic transducers and an electronic indicating device formed by an LCD display showing volume and flow. Volume resolution on the digital display is 0.00001 m³. Without buttons; non-legally relevant communication with the meter is possible via an NFC sensor connected on the register. Displays indication of each volume every two minutes - separately delivered volume for reverse flow and for forward flow; permanently shown delivered volume is the difference between the two. Has separation of software; SW versions and CRCs are displayed in the auto-rounding menu on the LCD display. Can be equipped by an impulse module which is not part of this certificate. Powered by a 3.6 V mains-independent battery. Shall be installed to operate in any positions. Sealed by a plastic seal on the plastic meter cover (plastic frame holding the display glass).

register.name: Water meter - Type: U-WR2 series

certified_type.module_designation: Ultrasonic water meters with electronic indication device
certified_type.description: Residential compact ultrasonic water meters with electronic indication device (types U-WR2-15, U-WR2-20 and U-WR2-25) for measuring, memorizing and displaying the volume of clean water in residential use. Measurement is based on the ultrasonic bidirectional transit-time principle (difference in time-of-flight of ultrasonic pulses with and against the flow). Meters with R500 can be installed in all positions; R800 in H position. Not designed to measure reverse flow. Essential parts: flow sensor (plastic cylindrical body with two reflection sheeds and two ultrasonic transducers) and calculator with indication device (PCB, 9-digit electronic scrolling LCD with indication range 999999.999 m³, one non-replaceable lithium battery for metering). Non-essential parts: filter, local optical port for communication types LoRaWAN Class A, NB-IoT Standard, two-wire pulse output, three-wire pulse output, WM-Bus, M-Bus (optionally), antenna (optionally), one battery for communication, pressure sensor selectable.

certified_type.description: Ultrasonic water meters with an electronic indicating device designed to measure, memorise and display the volume at metering conditions of water passing through the measurement transducer. The meters consist of a cast iron body with connecting screw threads (flanged connection), one pair of ultrasonic transducers and an electronic indicating device formed by an LCD display showing volume and flow. Displayed volume resolution is 0.0001 m³ and 0.001 m³. Legally non-relevant communication with the meter is possible via an optical sensor connected to the register. The meter has separation of software; SW versions and CRCs of the legally relevant part are displayed in the auto-rounding menu on the LCD. Each delivered volume (reverse and forward flow) is indicated every two minutes; the permanently shown volume is the difference between the two. Powered from 24 V DC mains with an internal battery for temporary power failure; mains power cable shielding by magnetic ferrite. May be installed in arbitrary positions. An optional impulse module is not part of this certificate.

certified_type.module_designation: Ultrasonic water meter with electronic indication device
certified_type.description: Compact ultrasonic water meter with electronic indication device designed to measure, memorise and display the volume of clean water passing through the measurement transducer at metering conditions, intended for residential use. Measurement is based on the ultrasonic bidirectional transit-time principle: the flow is measured by the difference in time-of-flight of ultrasonic pulses with flow (downstream) and opposite to flow (upstream). Essential parts: flow sensor (cylindrical brass body with two ultrasonic transducers), calculator and indication device (plastic housing directly mounted on the flow sensor, main PCB with LCD display and optical sensor, non-replaceable lithium battery). Non-essential parts: thermistor; pressure sensor (optional). Software versions V1-1.1 and V1-2.2.

certified_type.description: Density sensor (a sensor as part of a densitometer). In the metal housing, two parallel tubes are mounted which are set into a vibrating motion by a drive coil controlled by the transmitter. The two pick-off coils generate signals representative for the frequency of motion of the measurement tubes; the resonance frequency depends, among other things, on the density of the liquid in the measurement tubes. The transmitter can output this resonance frequency either directly or via serial communication. For software version 2.11 onwards, the transmitter when connected to an external pressure and temperature transmitter via HART is capable of calculating the line density and converting it to density at reference conditions (0 kPa, 15 °C via API Table 53A/53B/53D; 0 kPa, 20 °C via API Table 59A/59B/59D, as specified in API MPMS Chapter 11 Section 1, also known as ASTM D1250-07). These density values can be output via RS-485 Modbus serial communication, BELL 202 HART protocol or 4-20 mA analog signal. The density sensor is also capable of alcohol concentration measurement calculations according to OIML R22, density conversion for Fatty Acid Methyl Ester (FAME) according to EN14214:2008 + A1:2009 and density conversion for Methyl Ester. If the time period signal of the device is used as the output, the density sensor together with a pressure and temperature sensor must be connected to a flow computer, in which the actual density calculations and conversions then take place. For software version 2.10 and lower, together with the calibration constants, a connected flow computer (with optionally connected external process pressure and temperature transmitters) can calculate the liquid density under line conditions and/or under standard conditions.

register.name: Non-automatic weighing indicator - Type: ZM223

certified_type.description: The indicating device is designated the Avery Weigh-Tronix ZM223 and is designed to be used as part of a Class III or IIII non-automatic weighing instrument. It can connect to one analogue load receptor, or one analogue load receptor plus one BSQ digital base, or two BSQ digital load bases. The indicator consists of analogue-to-digital conversion, microprocessor control, power supply, keyboard, non-volatile memory for storage of calibration and weight data, and display contained within a single stainless-steel enclosure. The front has an operator LCD display (1.5-inch high 14-segment digits, annunciators, transflective segments for outdoor contrast, 4-colour backlight: green/red/yellow/orange) and a keyboard with 7 keys plus 12 numeric keys. Devices: semi-automatic zero-setting, initial zero-setting, zero-tracking, semi-automatic subtractive tare weighing, preset tare, recall of gross indication when tare is active, determination and indication of stability of equilibrium, power-up test, display test, printing, PLUs, alibi storage device, gravity compensation, event counters, real-time clock, command via external device (PC), status indicators, range-in-use indicators (multi-range variant), connection to up to 2 load receptors with load receptor number indicator. Interfaces: 2 x serial communication (2 x RS232, or 1 x RS232 plus 1 x QDT, or 2 x QDT), Ethernet, USB, Bluetooth, open collector outputs, 6 x programmable I/O (active-low inputs or open collector outputs). Optional: analog output card, STVS PCB, dual L/C STVS PCB, micro SD card interface. The interfaces do not have to be secured. Software comprises a segregated firmware OS (all legally relevant functionality, not modifiable) and a user application written in LUA (non-legally relevant). Securing via mainboard jumper or software securing with password-protected, non-resettable CAL and CONFIG event counters.

certified_type.description: Residential compact ultrasonic water meters with electronic indication device (types U-WR2-15, U-WR2-20 and U-WR2-25) designed to measure, memorize and display the volume of water passing through the measurement transducers at metering conditions. Measurement is based on the ultrasonic bidirectional transit-time principle (difference in time-of-flight of ultrasonic pulses downstream and upstream). Intended for measurement of volume of clean water in residential use. Not designed to measure reverse flow. Installable in all positions (R500) and H position (R800).

register.name: Water meter - ultrasonic - Type: Cordonel

certified_type.description: The water meters type Cordonel are designed to measure, memorise and display the volume at metering conditions of water passing through the measurement transducer. The water meter type Cordonel is a battery powered ultrasonic water meter working on the ultrasonic time-of-flight principle; the meter has three transducer pairs. The meter comprises a body with two pipe-shaped flanged end connections; the body has 6 openings for mounting the ultrasonic transducers as well as an opening for an optional pressure sensor. In the area of the measuring section the channel of measurement is constricted; body and measuring section are of symmetrical construction allowing bi-directional measurement with the same accuracy. With DN 50 to DN 125 the flow channel has a hexagonal cross-section and the ultrasonic measuring paths are arranged at a 120° angle to each other; with DN 150 the flow channel has a rectangular cross-section and the measuring paths are arranged parallel. The meter electronics is fixed in a waterproof IP68 register casing and calculates twice per second the transit time difference; the volume integration takes the invariable cross section and corrective calculations into account. The consumption value is shown permanently on a 9-digit, 7-segment LC display. The meters can be installed in horizontal and vertical position and are designed to measure reverse flow.

certified_type.module_designation: Ultrasonic water meters with electronic indication device
certified_type.description: The ultrasonic water meters LXC15, LXC20, LXC25 are residential compact ultrasonic water meters with electronic indication device, designed to measure, memorize and display the volume of clean water passing through the measurement transducers at metering conditions. The measurement is based on the ultrasonic bidirectional transit-time principle (difference in time-of-flight of ultrasonic pulses with flow and opposite to flow). The meters can be installed in horizontal or vertical positions and are not designed to measure the reverse flow. Essential parts: flow sensor (brass cylindrical body with inlet and outlet, inner plastic pipe supports, two reflection sheets and two ultrasonic transducers) and calculator with indication device directly mounted on the flow sensor (PCBA board, electronic scrolling LCD display with 9 digits and indication range of 99999.9999 m³, one non-replaceable lithium battery with 15 years lifetime). Optional non-essential parts: stainless steel ball valve, motor, and communication interfaces (optical port, pulse output, NB-IoT/GPRS/3G/4G/Cat1, MBus/RS485, LoRa/LoRaWan/Sigfox/WM-Bus).

register.name: Water meter - Single-jet - Type: Unico4/Unico4coder MP; Unico4e

certified_type.description: Single-jet impeller water meters for cold and hot water, designed according to the dry-register principle, with brass body and connecting screw threads. Water flows through a mechanical strainer, single-jet onto the impeller wheel; the flow-proportional rotary motion of the impeller is transmitted to the counter by a magnetic coupling; a sealing plate secured with a bayonet ring is located between impeller and totalizer. Unico4/Unico4coder MP water meters have a mechanical pointer roller counter with 5 rollers and reed contact (Unico4) or pointer roller counter with 8 rollers and absolute encoder (Unico4coder MP). Unico4e water meters have an electronic counter that senses the magnetic coupling of the hydraulics by means of TMR (resistive magnet) sensors; the firmware is split and runs on two microcontrollers, the metrology and display being the legally relevant part, while wM-Bus/LoRaWAN/NFC communication is not legally relevant. Adjustment by turning the sealing plate (Unico4e also electronically by changing the pulse value). Installation in four positions: horizontal with indicating device at top, horizontal with indicating device at side, vertical flow bottom-to-top with indicating device at side, vertical flow top-to-bottom with indicating device at side. The mechanical counter (Unico4coder MP) is available with composite housing IP67 or copper housing IP68 (manufacturer information, not certified).

register.applicant: Emerson Process Management Micro Motion Inc.

applicants.name: Emerson Process Management Micro Motion Inc.

manufacturers.name: Emerson Process Management Micro Motion Inc.

certified_type.description: A density sensor (a sensor as a part of a densitometer). In the metal housing of the density sensor, two parallel tubes are mounted which are set into a vibrating motion by a drive coil controlled by the transmitter. The two pick-off coils generate signals representative for the frequency of motion of the measurement tubes; the resonance frequency depends, among other things, on the density of the liquid in the measurement tubes. The transmitter can output this resonance frequency either directly or via serial communication. For software version 2.11 onwards, when connected to an external pressure and temperature transmitter via HART, the transmitter can calculate line density and convert it to density at reference conditions: 0 kPa / 15 °C using API MPMS Ch. 11.1 (ASTM D1250-07) Tables 53A/53B/53D, and 0 kPa / 20 °C using Tables 59A/59B/59D. Outputs via RS-485 Modbus serial communication, BELL 202 HART protocol or 4-20 mA analog signal. Also capable of alcohol concentration measurement calculations according to OIML R22 and density conversion for FAME according to EN14214:2008+A1:2009.

certified_type.description: Complete water meter consisting of an electromagnetic flow sensor (MAG5100W DN50-300 or MAG3100 DN350-600) and a signal transmitter (MAG8000CT). A constant pulsed DC current through the coil circuit generates a magnetic field through the sensor bore; a conductive liquid passing through the field induces a differential DC voltage between the measuring electrodes. The sensor has a steel tube and steel flanges with an electrically insulating lining. An optional wireless communication module is available.

certified_type.description: Electromagnetic water meter FM520, consisting of the FMS500 sensor and the FMT020 transmitter. A constant pulsed DC electrical current through the coil circuit results in a magnetic field through the sensor bore; when a conductive liquid passes through the magnetic field, a differential DC voltage proportional to the fluid velocity is induced between the measuring electrodes (Faraday's Law). Applications: water abstraction, water treatment, water distribution network (leak detection management), custody transfer water meters, irrigation, wastewater treatment, filtration plant, industrial water applications. For OIML R 49 the product can be used only for cold potable water and hot water. Available in 25 sizes DN50 to DN2000.
