register.name: Electromagnetic water meter - Type: BFG070

certified_type.description: Electromagnetic water meters type BFG070 designed to measure, memorise and display the volume at metering conditions of water passing through the measurement transducer. They consist of a flow sensor and an electronic calculating/indicating device. The flow sensor measures based on an induction principle with hard rubber lining, straight inlet (5 times the diameter) and outlet (3 times the diameter) length, without flow conditioner; the meter is designed to measure reverse flow. The meter must be equipped with a plastic cover over the electronics with a conductive coating on the inside; the LCD display is protected by a conductive metallic foil and all components must be conductively connected. Equipped with electronic indicating device (LCD) showing delivered volumes in cubic meters (positive, negative, total); normal resolution mode displays up to 00000000.001 m³/h and 00000000.001 m³, high resolution mode (used during calibration, set by factory tool protected by user, service and factory passwords) shows volume resolution of 0.001 L. Software version is shown after reset; checksum displayed via Info – FW Checksum. To be installed with the flow axis in horizontal and vertical (bottom-to-top and top-to-bottom) planes. Securing: one of the screws connecting the meter body and counter case is connected with the butts on the electronic output by a wire with a seal.

register.name: Ultrasonic water meters with electronic indications device - Type: LXCZ

certified_type.module_designation: Ultrasonic water meters with electronic indication device
certified_type.description: Ultrasonic water meter type LXCZ (family DN15, DN20, DN25) designed to measure, memorize and display the volume of water passing through the measurement transducers at metering conditions; intended for measurement of clean water volume in residential use. Compact residential ultrasonic water meter with electronic indication device; measurement based on ultrasonic bidirectional transit-time principle, flow measured by double-pulse system with positive and negative pulses depending on flow direction. Can be installed in horizontal and vertical position; not designed to measure reverse flow. Essential parts: brass cylindrical body firmly connected with plastic calculator housing and inner plastic pipe supports; flow sensor with two reflection sheets in the centre of the brass pipe section and two ultrasonic transducers upstream and downstream; calculator with PCB, electronic scrolling 8-digit LCD with indication range 99999.999 m³ and one replaceable lithium battery (Umax 3.6 V, nominal capacity 19 Ah, 10 years lifetime). Non-essential parts/options: filter, internal valve, motor for valve, strainer, remote controller for communication, pressure sensor (optional, with two non-replaceable batteries), wireless communication interfaces (IR, Bluetooth, WM-Bus, LoRa, LoRaWAN, NB-IoT Standard, GPRS, Cat.1, Sigfox) and pre-payment system.

certified_type.description: Automatic multi-dimensional measuring instrument (MDMI) designated MV-DLxxxx-0yy-y, where x and y may be 0-9 or A-Z and represent models with different housing colour, baseline or scan rate. Intended for scanning the dimensions of rectangular boxes moved on a transport belt below the camera. The instrument can measure objects of different colours and sizes but does not measure irregular objects. Consists of a 3D laser camera placed on a portal or mounted in the ceiling; the pictures from the camera of the object are transmitted to a PC, which analyses them and calculates the dimensions. The PC software includes a data storage device working as an alibi memory in which all performed measurements are stored; alternatively measurements are sent to a central system.

register.name: Non-automatic digital weighing instrument - Type: MU1

certified_type.description: The MU1 instrument is a class III or IIII, non-automatic weighing instrument with single-interval or dual-range, comprising an MU1 analog data processing unit, a load receptor, and a PC with display. The MU1 analog data processing unit is a single chip microprocessor based unit running on USB bus power; the PC user interface software presents the user interface, controls, and primary indications. Software is split into a metrological and an operational part; identification of the MU1 firmware can be observed on command from the PC user interface.

certified_type.description: Family of non-automatic weighing indicators and weight transmitters, single-interval or multi-interval (up to 3 intervals) and multi-range (up to 3 ranges). Software held in flash memory and not modifiable by the user; protected by hardware jumper on the main board or by software sealing with non-editable CAL and CONFIG modification counters (password-protected); legally relevant software identified by prefix/version with version 01 for all series. Devices include semi-automatic zero setting (≤ 4% Max), zero tracking (≤ 4% Max), semi-automatic subtractive tare weighing, pre-set tare, recall of gross indication, stability determination/indication, multi-range and multi-interval function, display check, printing, alibi storage, gravity compensation, event counters, manual checkweighing, real time clock, counting, command via external device, accumulation, battery level indicator, remote control, LCD or LED, peak hold (non-legal), and connection to up to 4 load receptors. Protected interfaces: RS-232, RS-485, Ethernet, Profibus, Profinet, DeviceNet, CANopen, Ethernet IP, EtherCAT, USB, WiFi, Bluetooth, RF, DC voltage input, control inputs/outputs, opto-isolated inputs, Photomosfet outputs, SENSOR digital input, analogue output and input. May also be connected to a tilt switch or tilt sensor.
